description:

Guy Fieri surprises three of his all-star friends by turning a savory showdown into a dessert battle; they'll have to transform diner classics into sweet treats before making a fried dessert using mystery ingredients from Crazy Can Roulette.

Four GGG winners return to Guy Fieri's Flavortown for a chance to take another crown in one big round; they must make a winner's dinner complete with an appetizer and entrée in an hourlong battle to shop the market for up to $20,000.

description:
All-Star Grocery Rush-a-Thon

description:

Inspired by the live music scene in Austin, Texas, and led by team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson, the Brawlers must listen closely and hit all the right notes with their BBQ feasts.

The grills and smokers are gone, and the Brawlers must go back to basics with raw wood, stone and salt blocks; team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson lead the competitors in their toughest team brawl yet.

description:

Inspired by hash browns and energized by eggs, four chefs wake up the judges' palates using baskets packed with breakfast foods; two chefs battle with breakfast sandwiches as entrées, while a strange coffee and meat dish prove challenging.

title: Chopped
description:

The chefs are shocked when abalone appears in their appetizer baskets; a fusion soup and a colorful veggie are in the entrée basket, and an unwelcome egg is in the dessert basket.

description:

In the appetizer round, the chefs show that they have what it takes to transform leftovers into a meal; in the entrée round, the competitors attempt to impress the judges using a variety of tools and techniques.

The Noodle Queen, Suchanan Chef Bao Bao Aksornnan, is ready to settle a score with Bobby Flay that's 10 years in the making; she's using her arsenal of Thai flavors to impress judge Viet Pham, who has beaten the Titans, and even Bobby, twice.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:

Bobby Flay invites rising star Chef Ashleigh Shanti to face-off against the Titans; she keeps the Titans guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking, while Chef Wylie Dufresne doles out his criticisms.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:

Bobby Flay challenges the Titans with Chef Ayaka Guido, and as the right hand to Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten, she comes prepared with her Michelin training; the Titans are shocked by the return of Chef Frank Prisinzano and his bold opinions.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chefs and business partners Scott Calhoun and David Feola must challenge each other before they take Bobby Flay down; Anne Burrell and Michael Symon give Bobby the business.

Chefs Noah Zamler and Aerin Zavory are here to make sure Bobby Flay doesn't walk away with the competition; they've got Geoffrey Zakarian and Brooke Williamson on their team to pummel Bobby with pranks.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Katie Lee Biegel and David Burtka dial up the distractions while chefs Lambert Givens and Jesse Houston try to ring Bobby Flay's bell.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chef Michael Voltaggio and actress Ellie Kemper bring the pain as chefs Travis McGinty and Suzanne Vizethann crack more than a few eggs in their quest to take down Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chef Antonia Lofaso partners with comedian Leslie Jones to bring the nuttiness, as chefs Josh Elliot and Vicky Colas attempt to get the last laugh over Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Eddie Jackson and Poppy Harlow break the news to Bobby Flay that he is going to lose; Chefs Dayna Lee and Enrique Lozano hope to flatten the competition.

Host Noah Cappe samples Southern hospitality on fairgrounds across the county; the carnival treats he finds are all infused with a down-home goodness that makes each bite taste like Southern sugar and spice.

title: Tournament of Champions
description:
S05 E05 — The Super 16 Step Up
Guy Fieri gathers some of the world's greatest chefs for an intense, single-elimination culinary tournament; emotions run high as the chefs battle to stay in the competition, and surprises unfold both inside and outside the arena.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S19 E05 — Sweet & Savory: Dishing It Out at Dollywood
The remaining four teams take on massive crowds and amusement park chaos at Dollywood in Pigeon Forge, TN. Guest judge Arnold Myint joins Tyler Florence for a potato-focused redemption battle and an emotional elimination.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S19 E06 — Sweet & Savory: The Great Kentucky Cook-Off
In Louisville, Ky., Tyler Florence gives the final three teams a taste challenge featuring the state fruit, the blackberry; in the last redemption battle, guest judge Kelsey Murphy tasks teams with creating a dish centered around beer cheese.

title: Pitmasters
description:
S01 E08 — The Final Burn
The final two teams compete head-to-head preparing a five-course barbecue tasting menu; judges Andrew Zimmern, Ernest Servantes, Jess Pryles and Moe Cason decide who will walk away with $30,000 and the title of Pitmasters Champion.

Alex Guarnaschelli makes her return to Flavortown Market by taking on Rocco DiSpirito and Brian Malarkey; Guy Fieri hits them with his new swap wheel.

Guy Fieri sends talented chefs running through the aisles of Flavortown Market for the chance to make some serious dough; they face real-world challenges as they compete to be the last chef standing in this high-stakes cooking competition.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:

Fieri invites firefighters to partner with all-star chefs for a special team competition. The firefighters and their all-star sous chefs make a 20-minute firehouse breakfast to win $2,500, followed by a complete firehouse dinner to win up to $20,000.

In Cathedral City, a barbecue joint piles up the meats; in Norfolk, a wing spot goes big with their buffalo and kills it with their Cajun; in Maui, a place dishes out lobster grilled cheese followed by a shaved ice specialty.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E13 — College-Town Champs
Guy's rolling into college towns; in Columbus, Ohio, a pierogi paradise dishing out their specialties and a barbecue truck smoking premiere pork; in Boulder, Colorado, a legit Thai joint serving knockout noodles and off-the-chain chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Sandwiches and serious spice; in Longmont, a spot with a pork burger and cauliflower; in Columbus, a Chicago-style joint with Italian beef and gyros; Aarti Sequeira and Jet Tila join Guy in LA, where a chef dishes out fiery Thai specialties.

A deep-dish pie and twisted-up breadsticks at a Chicago-style spot in Tucson, Ariz.; duck wings and bite-size beef Wellington at a pub in Wilmington, N.C.; in Miami, NFL coach Jon Gruden rides shotgun with Guy to a place with out-of-the-box Cuban.

S28 E01 — Mom's Kitchen
Guy Fieri grabs grub straight out of Mom's kitchen; in Boulder, Colo., a mother-son team serve up dan dan noodles and steamed buns; in Columbus, Ohio, a Jamaican joint dishes out jerk chicken; in Arizona, a family spot cooks Latin cuisine.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E08 — Meaty Mashup
In Little Rock, Ark., a gas station-turned-eatery pumps bison into a burrito and piles pork onto cornmeal waffles; in Santa Rosa, Calif., a Vietnamese joint makes pho and barbecue pork; in Sonoma, Calif., a barbecue spot loads up a monster burger.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S33 E04 — Far-Flung Flavor
A Southwest-Middle Eastern quick stop slinging the shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe; a funky joint serving up outrageous Scandinavian specialties in Kansas City; in El Paso, a tortilla factory turning out top-notch tamales and tostadas.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E05 — Standout Seafood
A restaurant-market in Vancouver combines sustainability with killer cooking, including bouillabaisse and salmon fish and chips; a fresh-catch institution in Kauai, Hawaii, puts out prime-time poke; a raw bar in Chico, Calif., cooks up Asian flavors.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S40 E04 — Taste of the Tropics
Guy Fieri is loading up on tropical flavor, starting in a Florida spot serving up lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S42 E11 — Food Network Super Chefs
Guy Fieri hits up joints owned by Food Network super chefs; Maneet Chauhan serves up her creative spin on Indian recipes in Nashville, Tenn.; Michael Symon fires up pork belly at his barbecue spot in Cleveland.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S45 E04 — Interesting Italian
Guy Fieri is digging into all kinds of Italian; in Santa Barbara, Calif., Dennis Miller's riding shotgun for prime pizza; in Las Vegas, a vegan joint puts its spin on an Italian sandwich; a funky pizzeria stuffs chicken parm into stromboli.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S46 E13 — Tasty Time Travel
Guy Fieri's headed on some tasty trips back in time, starting with an old schoolhouse in Ohio that has a comfort food curriculum; former church in Redmond, Ore., puts out heavenly pizza; a retro joint in Stamford, Conn., dishes out diner classics.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S48 E12 — From Spicy to Sticky
Guy Fieri savors both spicy and sweet eats; in St. Simons Island, GA, a bomb bakery plates righteous rum cake; a pizza restaurant in Boulder, CO, fires up artisan pies; a spot in San Antonio, Texas, delivers dynamite duck.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Guy Fieri's finding flavor, starting with a Gainesville, Fla., bagel shop serving carrot-style lox on salted rosemary; then a Baton Rouge, La., joint is chargrilling oysters, and a spot in Naples, Fla., is serving prime-time pastrami.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Fieri's traveling back for a world of flavor! An Irish pub-restaurant in Louisville, KY, is going strong with scrumptious salmon rillettes, a Chicago joint is serving up steamed pork buns, and a rocking spot in Texas is churning out chicharron tacos.

description: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out!

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S04 E03 — Girl Meets Grill
Molly Yeh fires up the outdoor grill to make her favorite tailgating recipes including spicy cheddar juicy lucies with homemade chili potato chips and sesame avocado salsa on the side, and grilled corn on the cob slathered with a tangy kimchi mayo.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S04 E12 — Campfire Cookout
Molly Yeh is putting together some delicious campfire favorites and reliving her childhood by camping out in her backyard; dinner and dessert by the fire start with bonfire eggs with green peppers and cheese cooked right in the coals.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:

Molly Yeh makes a housewarming dinner of Midwest-Jewish mashups; the menu includes BBQ brisket sandwich with caraway coleslaw on pretzel challah buns, scallion cream cheese grilled corn and rugelach cookie salad for dessert.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:

For her late-night date night with Nick, Molly Yeh pulls out all the stops with her juicy steak party sub and scrumptious grilled potato salad with zhoug mayo; she makes orange blossom blondie ice cream coated in a white chocolate raspberry shell.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:

Veggie-packed pasta primavera; bacon cheeseburgers; french fries.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree answers cookout questions from friends and locals; she shares a chicken fajita salad and cilantro lime dressing arranged as a stunning centerpiece, plus pepperoni potato salad and Southern panzanella; Ree also makes grilled sheet pan s'mores.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S26 E13 — Dinner on the Grill
Ree Drummond makes a Mexican-inspired family dinner on the grill, and Ladd pitches in with the cooking; marinated Carne Asada, teamed up with skewers of juicy chipotle glazed shrimp; corn and squash salad; grilled pineapple with cream.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree Drummond gets grilling with herby grilled shrimp and scallop skewers along with savory grilled steak skewers; she prepares charred broccoli and cauliflower salad, grilled Yukon gold potatoes and coconut cream icebox pie with grilled pineapple.

title: The Kitchen

The summer is coming to an end, but the party is just getting started in the kitchen with easy recipes for Labor Day cookouts.

title: The Kitchen

Geoffrey Zakarian starts by sharing his mushroom turkey burger; Katie Lee makes a meatless grilled Halloumi sandwich with watermelon relish; Sunny Anderson with her meatloaf burgers; hot dogs with mustard and relish; smashed burger.

Chef Gabe Bertaccini shows you the heart of real Italian cooking: simple, fresh ingredients and family recipes with a whole lot of love.

Blowtorches spark dangerous kitchen chaos, terrible recipe ideas go horribly wrong,and dogs and other animals steal food at the worst possible times.Esther Choi, Joe Sasto, and Kalen Allen react to the madness with expert insight and strong opinions.

Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey and Gabe Bertaccini react to the internet's messiest kitchen disasters and food clips, offering their professional opinions and predicting the outcomes of various culinary mishaps.

title: Kitchen Chaos
description:
S01 E09 — The Great Outdoors and I Do Disasters
Campfire cooking adventures heat up, wedding cakes collapse and drive-thru encounters take turns as Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey, Gabe Bertaccini, Adrienne Cheatham and Zac Young weigh in with hilarious reactions and culinary expertise.
